items.headline: SGA's Historic 20-Point Streak Snapped at 141 Games
items.summary: Oklahoma City Thunder star and reigning NBA MVP Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's remarkable streak of 141 consecutive games with 20 or more points came to an end on Thursday night. Gilgeous-Alexander scored 17 points in the Thunder's 96-84 victory over the Denver Nuggets.

items.headline: 76ers Erase 29-Point Deficit to Stun Cavaliers
items.summary: The Philadelphia 76ers pulled off a massive comeback in their home opener, overcoming a 29-point deficit to defeat the Cleveland Cavaliers 114-106 on Thursday. Tyrese Maxey led the charge with 32 points, supported by Joel Embiid's 24 points, in a thrilling performance alongside new additions LeBron James and Jaylen Brown.

items.headline: 76ers Stage Stunning Comeback Against Cavaliers
items.summary: The 76ers overcame a 29-point deficit to defeat the Cavaliers in their home opener. Tyrese Maxey led all scorers with 32 points for Philadelphia.

items.headline: Thunder Top Nuggets as SGA's Streak Ends
items.summary: The Thunder secured a win over the Nuggets, but the storyline was Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's 20-point scoring streak coming to an end with 17 points.

items.headline: Tyrese Maxey Dominates with 32 Points
items.summary: Maxey's 32-point performance was crucial in the 76ers' comeback victory over the Cavaliers.

items.headline: Chet Holmgren's Strong Outing
items.summary: Chet Holmgren contributed significantly to the Thunder's win over the Nuggets, posting 41.5 fantasy points.

items.headline: Knicks vs. Celtics in Eastern Conference Battle
items.summary: Defending champion NYK faces Mitchell Robinson and BOS in a highly anticipated Eastern Conference matchup. Both teams are looking for their first win after losing their season openers.

items.headline: Hawks Visit Hornets
items.summary: The Atlanta Hawks travel to Spectrum Center to take on the Charlotte Hornets.

items.headline: Mavericks Face Pacers
items.summary: The Dallas Mavericks are set to clash with the Indiana Pacers at Gainbridge Fieldhouse.

items.headline: Timberwolves Take on Magic
items.summary: The Minnesota Timberwolves visit the Orlando Magic tonight.

items.headline: Raptors Battle Wizards
items.summary: The Toronto Raptors face the Washington Wizards tonight.

items.headline: Pistons Host Heat
items.summary: The Detroit Pistons, coming off a season-opening win against Boston, host the Miami Heat.

items.headline: Bulls vs. Bucks in Central Division Showdown
items.summary: The Chicago Bulls travel to Fiserv Forum to play the Milwaukee Bucks.

items.headline: Rockets and Spurs Square Off
items.summary: Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs look to bounce back from a rough opener as they host the Houston Rockets in Austin.

items.headline: Pelicans Visit Jazz in Western Conference Clash
items.summary: Both the Pelicans and Jazz are seeking their first win of the season after dropping their openers. Dejounte Murray leads the Pelicans, while Keyonte George is a key scorer for the Jazz.

items.headline: Grizzlies Face Warriors
items.summary: The Memphis Grizzlies travel to take on the Golden State Warriors.

items.headline: Battle for LA: Clippers vs. Lakers
items.summary: The LA Clippers and Los Angeles Lakers face off in a highly anticipated rivalry game at Crypto.com Arena. The Clippers will be without Bradley Beal, Jordan Miller, and Brandon Ingram due to injuries, while the Lakers are missing Cameron Carr and Adou Thiero.

items.headline: Trail Blazers vs. Kings
items.summary: The Portland Trail Blazers go on the road to face the Sacramento Kings.

items.headline: Defending Champion Knicks Drop Season Opener
items.summary: The New York Knicks, after celebrating their championship with ring and banner ceremonies, fell to the new-look Philadelphia 76ers 106-100 in their season opener.

items.headline: Celtics Squander Lead in Opening Loss to Pistons
items.summary: The Boston Celtics suffered a 121-113 loss to the Detroit Pistons in their season opener, despite Paul George's 38 points, after squandering a 22-point third-quarter lead.

items.headline: Wembanyama Aims for Bounce-Back Performance
items.summary: After a challenging season opener where he shot just 1-for-13, Victor Wembanyama looks to rebound when the Spurs face the Rockets. He emphasized needing to 'let go' and 'think less' to play his preferred style of basketball.

items.headline: Clippers Face Lakers with Key Players Out
items.summary: The LA Clippers will be without Bradley Beal (knee), Jordan Miller (shoulder), and Brandon Ingram (heel) for their game against the Lakers. Miller is expected to be re-evaluated in six months after rotator cuff surgery.

items.headline: Lakers Deal with Injuries Against Clippers
items.summary: The Los Angeles Lakers will be missing Cameron Carr (oblique) and Adou Thiero (knee) in their rivalry game against the Clippers. Jake LaRavia (ankle) is questionable.

items.headline: Jazz Suffer Key Injuries Early in Season
items.summary: The Utah Jazz are dealing with injuries to Trey Alexander (knee) and Tony Bradley (quadriceps), both day-to-day. Jusuf Nurkić will miss at least four weeks with a partial plantar plate tear in his right foot.
